Design and implement the best possible on-screen steering wheel interaction for touch devices in the current Racing26 driving simulator. Replace the left/right mobile steering buttons with a true analog steering-wheel gesture as the DEFAULT mobile steering control. Focus narrowly on gesture geometry, pointer capture, continuous analog output, centering/return behavior, multi-touch coexistence with throttle/brake, and predictable full-lock limits. Inspect current App.tsx, ControlsOverlay.tsx, mobileControls.ts, MouseSteeringInput.ts and related tests. Preserve physics conventions and existing keyboard/mouse controls. Do not tune tire grip or vehicle physics to mask input defects. Add deterministic tests for wheel angle mapping/centering where practical. The wheel should feel usable in both portrait and landscape and must not cause page scroll, zoom, text selection, or accidental browser gestures. Propose an implementation patch, not just advice. Run/require npm run test:mobile, relevant steering tests, npm run test:conventions, npm run test:m5-validation:strict, and npm run build.
